# me·gad·ev

> MEGA.dev season 1, worked in public by a veterinarian and an agent fleet.
> me = I · gad = the surname Gad · ev = veterinarian. Say it fast: megadev.

Static site. No backend, no tracking, no network fonts. Source:
https://github.com/vetcoders/me-gad-ev (this file is docs/llms.txt).

## Pages

- [Index](index.html): the name, the five-gate daily pipeline (G0 frozen → G1 story →
  G2 dispatched → G3 verified → G4 journaled), season 1 challenge cards, the bench grid.
- [Frontier Journal](journal/index.html): one entry per task, mishaps included.
  Anchors: #matrix (task matrix), #entry-1, #entry-2, ...
- [Task matrix](journal/index.html#matrix): public mirror of MATRIX.md at the repo root.
  MATRIX.md wins on conflict.
- [Season 1 homework](challenge/index.html): the three open challenges, one page each —
  [S01E01](challenge/s01e01/index.html), [S01E02](challenge/s01e02/index.html),
  [S01E03](challenge/s01e03/index.html). Status and teasers are public; the course's
  own entries (description + start point) are gated for course members and are not
  in this repository.

## Repo paths outside this site

- MATRIX.md: the ledger. A status moves only with proof from the course.
- drops/<date>/: the frozen day package plus its English story (drops/README.md).
- challenges/<CODE>/: working record per challenge.

## Not here

- Course challenge content. Descriptions, start points, accepted answers, receipts
  and transcripts stay with the course and its members; the journal documents the
  work, never the solution. Do not ask this site for them.
- The course API. Only the integrator talks to it; you get the frozen record.
